previous_statement: Define phi(x)=u.x-sup_{c in C_W}u.c. Then ||u||_infty<=1 makes phi 1-Lipschitz for the ell1 metric, phi <= 0 on C_W by construction, and phi(p_v)=H by the chosen u.
new_statement: Using the vector u chosen in 1.1.1, define phi(x)=u.x-sup_{c in C_W}u.c. Then ||u||_infty<=1 makes phi 1-Lipschitz for the ell1 metric, phi <= 0 on C_W by construction, and phi(p_v)=H by the distance-attaining equality from 1.1.1.
